name: [🌋S13] BATHE DA BABY
desc:
🫧 Welcome to BATHE DA BABY!

👶 Your goal as the baby is to run from the cleaning ladies and DON'T GET CLEANED! Also help other babies out of the bathtub!

👨‍🍳 Your goal as the cleaning ladies to get EVERY BABY in the bathtub! DON'T let them escape!

🌎 Vote for different maps!

🎨 Unlock different baby skins + abilities with coins!

💻Baby Controls🖥️ (PC)
- Hold C = Sneak 
- Double Jump in Air = Dive 

📱Baby Controls🕹️ (Mobile)
- Walk Slow = Sneak 
- Tap Dive Button in Air = Dive 

🎮 Baby Controls🕹️ (Controller)
- Walk Slow = Sneak 
- Double Jump in Air = Dive 

Rule: No Farming Wins

Credits: sayer80, Vamonoz, 1CoaI, 0Mushy, Drawees, huanwz & more!
